title: Rollback command generation for bad changes
description: Automatically generates revert commands when a problematic change is identified, reducing MTTR.
example_prompt: "A problematic change was detected on resource '{resource_id}' at {timestamp}. Based on Change Analysis, identify what was modified. Generate the az CLI or ARM API command to revert the change to its previous value. Include a safety check (--what-if where available)."
